h1.en: The DN200 90° Concrete Pump Elbow inquiry starts from the printed page
h1.zh: DN200 90度混凝土泵弯管的询盘从已印页面开始

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists the DN200 90° Concrete Pump Elbow at /products/concrete-pump-elbow-dn200-90. Copy only the printed cells: Part type Concrete pump elbow; Nominal diameter DN200; Bend 90° / R275; Label Dedicated concrete pump-truck pipe; Mounting Heel bracket with fixing hole; Commercial terms No small-batch shipping; no published list price. This page does not print a theoretical output. Do not invent m³/h. Ask Xingtai which listed machine matches the rate you need. This page does not print a horizontal / vertical pair. Leave that cell blank and ask Xingtai. Do not copy a distance from a different model. This page does not print motor kilowatts or an engine rating. Say whether the site has grid power or diesel, and ask Xingtai. Do not guess a kilowatt number. This page does not print a maximum aggregate or particle size. Send the size anyway, and ask Xingtai whether this listed part or machine accepts it. OEM or a change starts from the listed model at /products/concrete-pump-elbow-dn200-90. Send the change to Xingtai. Do not invent a model name or a performance number the page does not print. No price is printed on the product page. Confirm the price with Xingtai. The photograph on this note is a content image from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Original_equipment_manufacturer. It shows: Supply chain pyramid. It is a reference picture for the inquiry topic. It is not a Hebei Pinjin Machinery nameplate, not a quotation, and not an export case.

body.en: Put /products/concrete-pump-elbow-dn200-90 in the subject. The published cells are: Part type Concrete pump elbow; Nominal diameter DN200; Bend 90° / R275; Label Dedicated concrete pump-truck pipe; Mounting Heel bracket with fixing hole; Commercial terms No small-batch shipping; no published list price. Leave any cell the page does not print empty.
body.zh: 主题里写上 /products/concrete-pump-elbow-dn200-90。已公布的格子是：配件类型 混凝土泵弯管; 公称直径 DN200; 弯曲 90° / R275; 铭牌 混凝土泵车专用管; 安装 弯头支架，带固定孔; 商务条款 不支持小批量发货；无公开标价。页面没有印的格子保持空白。

heading.en: What to ask Xingtai instead of guessing
heading.zh: 该问邢台，而不是自己猜

body.en: OEM or a change starts from the listed model at /products/concrete-pump-elbow-dn200-90. Send the change to Xingtai. Do not invent a model name or a performance number the page does not print. Also send country and purchase timing as facts about your order. Do not turn them into a promised lead time or an export-country list. No price is printed on the product page. Confirm the price with Xingtai.
body.zh: OEM 或改动从已列型号 /products/concrete-pump-elbow-dn200-90 开始。把要改的内容发给邢台。不要自编型号，也不要写页面没有印的性能数字。同时把国家和采购时间作为订单事实发来。不要把它们写成承诺交期，也不要写成出口国名单。产品页没有印价格。价格向邢台询盘确认。
